QuestInfo.name: Welcome to the Hollow
QuestInfo.0: #b#p313##k revealed that the fairies sealed some of their own kin away in the dark. Some of them may still live within the #b#m010006000##k.
QuestInfo.1: I must find the newly opened abyss at the bottom of #b#m010002071##k, or take the other path down at the bottom right of #b#m010005054##k, and descend into the #b#m010006000##k to see what remains of the fairy homeland.
QuestInfo.2: I descended into the Hollow and met #b#p702##k, a cave fairy who chose to stay behind in the dark decades ago.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #questorder1#Descend into #b#m10006000##k and look for surviving fairies.

0.0: If the breach is open in #b#m010002071##k, you must travel there immediately. The opening should be at the very bottom of the tunnel.\nIf the tunnel is crowded, there is another way down at the bottom right of #b#m010005054##k.
0.1: Descend into the depths of the #b#m010006000##k and look for any fairies who survived. We must know what happened to them.

yes.0: Do not underestimate the darkness below. Prepare yourself and go at once.

no.0: I understand the hesitation. Return when you are ready to face the abyss.

1.0: A human?! You made it all the way down to our camp? I didn't expect to see a surface-dweller so soon. The magical seals above must have finally collapsed!
1.1: Welcome to the #b#m010006000##k. I'm #b#p702##k. We are the kin who chose to stay behind in the dark when the elders sealed the entrance above.
1.2: Someone had to watch over the deepest roots of the World Tree... and the old halls where our people once lived.
1.3: I would love to show you around, but we have our own messes to clean up down here right now.
1.4: Still, you braved the dark to find us, and you have my thanks. Rest here in our sanctuary as long as you like, human. And talk to the others. A few of them could use a hand.

npc.0: Why do you linger? The breach is at the bottom of #b#m010002071##k, and another path leads down from the bottom right of #b#m010005054##k. Descend into the #b#m010006000##k and learn whether any of the fairies survived.
